decision_cruda.rationale: LH-06 down at C512-01 (radio+CMMS agree, likely repair 11:30). Stope has 144 t at 7.2 g/t (~33 oz). Central is not truck-limited (91 t/h vs 61 inflow). Lend LH-08 from the infrastructure heading (0.2 oz/h cost); it arrives in 0.33 h and loads at 25.4 t/h, about 17 t before lunch and more if the repair slips. Cost is about 1 oz. The critical-path LH-09 stays put. LH-10 is in PM until 11:00, so it is not used.
